trials.instruction: Place the white desk fan onto the Tan colored mat facing the robot.
Grab the fan with small round shape and set it on the Beige mat facing the robot.
Grab the plastic fan with the left arm and position it on the Turquoise mat facing the robot.
Grab the plastic fan with the right arm and position it on the Brown mat facing the robot.
Use the right arm to grab the portable curved handle fan and place it on the Silver mat facing the robot.
Grab the fan with small round shape with the left arm and position it on the Green mat facing the robot.
Grab the beige circular blade fan and set it on the Orange mat.
Pick the plastic fan, place it on the Black mat, face it toward the robot
Grab the plastic fan and set it on the Coral mat.
Use the right arm to grab the off-white fan with beige accents and place it on the Coral mat facing the robot.
